sections.title: How it works
sections.body:
Image-file selection requires both an initialized image element and matching file data.

The implementation serializes database-mode JSON, generates a key, passes it to compression, and posts the payload.

With a truthy response ID, it builds the URL fragment, awaits file saving, then returns the URL if saving succeeds.

Import fetches by ID. Only with an OK response and successful keyed decoding and JSON parsing does this path return elements and app state, each defaulting to null.

Non-OK responses alert and return an empty object; errors inside the new-format decoding/parsing block invoke the legacy decoder.

sections.title: A closer look
sections.body:
The URL fragment avoids query parameters specifically to keep the key from being sent to the server, according to the source comment.

Export returns the size-specific error only when the response lacks a truthy ID and error_class equals RequestTooLargeError.
